metadata.title: FlowDesk · Software access requests
metadata.description: Request, approve and track software access in one clear workflow. Explore the FlowDesk demo.

welcome.eyebrow: Software access, with a clear process
welcome.title:
Every request.
A clear next step.
welcome.description: Move software access requests out of scattered messages and into one shared workflow. Employees request, approvers decide, and IT records the work.
welcome.note: No registration. A private demo space with sample data.
welcome.requestDescription: Explain the tool and access you need.
welcome.approveDescription: Give each decision a clear owner.
welcome.completeDescription: Record the work and keep its history.
welcome.footer: One workflow. Three perspectives. Full traceability.

approver.title: Decide with context
approver.description: Review each request and keep a record of your decision.

it.title: Complete the workflow
it.description: Manage approved access and record the work you carry out.
